name: Network Service Discovery
description: Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of services running on remote hosts, including those that may be vulnerable to remote software exploitation. Methods include port scans and vulnerability scans.

name: Active Scanning
description: Adversaries may execute active reconnaissance scans to gather information that can be used during targeting.

name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
description: Adversaries may attempt to exploit a weakness in an Internet-facing computer or program including SQL injection and other web application flaws.

name: Brute Force
description: Adversaries may use brute force techniques to gain access to accounts when passwords are unknown or when password hashes are obtained.

name: Password Guessing
description: Adversaries with no prior knowledge of legitimate credentials may guess passwords to attempt access to accounts.

name: Network Denial of Service
description: Adversaries may perform Network Denial of Service attacks to degrade or block availability of targeted resources to users.

name: Endpoint Denial of Service
description: Adversaries may perform Endpoint Denial of Service attacks to deny availability of services to users.

name: Remote Services
description: Adversaries may use valid accounts to log into a service specifically designed to accept remote connections.

name: Application Layer Protocol
description: Adversaries may communicate using OSI application layer protocols to avoid detection and blend with existing traffic.

name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
description: Adversaries may abuse command and script interpreters to execute commands, scripts, or binaries.

name: PowerShell
description: Adversaries may abuse PowerShell to perform a number of actions, including discovery and execution.

name: Valid Accounts
description: Adversaries may obtain and abuse credentials of existing accounts as a means of gaining Initial Access, Persistence, Privilege Escalation, or Defense Evasion.
